title: FileNode wire format: upgrade -14 to -16
description: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-16: nodeType -> @type (required on create, no inference; values File/Directory/SymLink); File type -> mediaType; filters type/typeMatch -> mediaType/mediaTypeMatch; properties not defined for a node's type MUST be omitted, not null.
